ruleDefinitions.name: Shadow Copies Deletion Using Operating Systems Utilities
ruleDefinitions.description: Shadow Copies deletion using operating systems utilities

sequences.query: ((((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wmic\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\vssadmin\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\diskshadow\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "PowerShell\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "pwsh\.dll" OR process_original_file_name = "wmic\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "VSSADMIN\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "diskshadow\.exe")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*shadow.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*delete.*")))) OR (((process_path = RGX("\\\\wbadmin\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "WBADMIN\.EXE") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*delete.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*catalog.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*quiet.*")))) OR (((process_path = RGX("\\\\vssadmin\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "VSSADMIN\.EXE") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*resize.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*shadowstorage.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*unbounded.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/MaxSize\\=.*")))))
